question: What was Rowan's PHQ-9 score on Jan 26?

plan.reading: Asks for the PHQ-9 score recorded on 2026-01-26 (year taken from the plan period). The question assumes a PHQ-9 was given that day, so the calls check whether one exists before a score is reported. No contact class needs to be defined.
other_readings: If no PHQ-9 was given on Jan 26, the user may mean the closest PHQ-9 in the episode, or a copy or mention of an earlier score that was filed on Jan 26.
plan.notes: The question gives only the first name "Rowan". The one match in the collection is Rowan Mercer (HG-M042). If no distinct PHQ-9 is dated 2026-01-26, say so and give the dated results from the episode instead. Don't treat a copied or mentioned score as a new result.
